_source: Seed Scenario 1 in docs/claimflow-luo-playbook.md, Step 3.1 — this is the flagship demo case actually built in Luo.
complaintText: Hello, I just opened the parcel delivered by DPD yesterday. The vase is completely shattered into pieces! This was supposed to be a birthday gift for tomorrow. Please help immediately.

evidenceCheck.note: DPD requires the outer-box and shipping-label photos within 48 hours of delivery to keep the damage claim active (see demo-data/policy-documents/carrier-claim-rules.md).

generatedCustomerRequest.text: We're very sorry the vase arrived shattered. To file the carrier claim in time, could you also send a photo of the outer shipping box and a photo of the shipping label? One photo of each is enough, and time is short — DPD requires this evidence within 48 hours of delivery.

resolutionProposal.rationale: Fragile-goods category (glass) with a confirmed damage photo; policy allows immediate replacement pending stock, without waiting for the carrier claim outcome (Complaint Guide 3.2). Outer-box and shipping-label photos are still missing and needed within DPD's 48-hour evidence window.

policySource.excerpt: 3.2 For fragile-goods categories (glass, ceramics), a confirmed shipping-damage complaint with complete evidence is eligible for immediate replacement, pending stock availability, without waiting for the carrier claim outcome.

customerReplyDraft.text: We're sorry the vase arrived broken. We're sending a replacement via priority courier as soon as we have the outer-box and shipping-label photos for the carrier claim.
customerReplyDraft.internalSummaryEn: Fragile-goods damage claim, product photo received, box + label photos requested within DPD's 48-hour window. Replacement recommended once evidence is complete.
